standard: EvoPilot native JSON; not an industry-certified Harness format

clauses.selector: Policy test boolean success/failure and evaluation errors
clauses.adoption: Keep PASS, FAIL and ERROR separate. INDETERMINATE for missing observations and N/A for explicitly disabled applicability are EvoPilot additions.
cases: boolean outcomes and execution errors remain distinct

clauses.selector: Evaluation inputs, instance selection and evaluation results
clauses.adoption: Pin case identity, source revision/digest, configuration and evaluated definitions for reproducible evidence. No benchmark execution or SWE-bench compatibility claim.
cases: evidence bindings and deterministic package integrity
all kinds retain honest unresolved dependency pins

clauses.adoption: Severity describes an observation independently of blocking and project consequences. Native info/warning/error/critical are not an OTel numeric encoding.
cases: nonblocking warning never grants authority or mutates version

provenance.basis: Shared PROV-inspired source records and exact source mappings
provenance.claim: No W3C PROV conformance or external source authentication
